content.text: Clause 12.3 expressly disclaims any restriction on our business. No redline needed.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, or conducting business in any field or territory, and records that Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. A full sweep of Customer Responsibilities (§12), the licence restrictions in §13.4 (limited to reverse engineering, interference, security bypass and unlawful use), compliance (§26), assignment (§24) and General (§30) found no build/buy, competing-product, field-of-use or territory prohibition binding Customer. The only competition restraint (§12.4) binds Vendor from developing a service competing with Customer's analytics products, which benefits us and is not flagged. This sits at the preferred position.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
